name: isolation_synthetic
source: Synthetic isolation fixture. Every id, query and judgment here describes the ledger built by tests/synthetic_scope_db.py. The audit this matrix is modelled on, and the real-ledger numbers, live outside this repo.
id_format: 8-char decision_id prefixes, unique in the 13-record synthetic ledger; the eval matches hits by prefix
binding_note: binding.project is the caller's project (null = unbound). binding.tools are the tools that caller touches; find allows fleet, the caller's project, and those tools.
unbound_note: judgment: for an unbound caller (project null) every project-domain record is out of scope; those hits are reported as unbound_project_hits, not cross_project_leaks
